# POST /storeDetailAndSubmitThirdParty - Store details and submit a payout

This endpoint is **deprecated** and no longer supports new integrations. Do one of the following:

- If you are building a new integration, use the POST [/transfers](https://docs.adyen.com/api-explorer/transfers/latest/post/transfers) endpoint instead.

- If you are already using the Payout API, reach out to your Adyen contact to learn how to migrate to the Transfers API.

With the Transfers API, you can:

- Handle multiple payout use cases with a single API.

- Use new payout functionalities, such as instant payouts to bank accounts.

- Receive webhooks with more details and defined transfer states.

For more information about the payout features of the Transfers API, see our [Payouts](https://docs.adyen.com/payouts/payout-service) documentation.

Submits a payout and stores its details for subsequent payouts.

The submitted payout must be confirmed or declined either by a reviewer or via `/confirmThirdParty` or `/declineThirdParty` calls.

## Servers
- https://pal-test.adyen.com/pal/servlet/Payout/v68

## Parameters

### Request body
| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| additionalData | object (string) | No | This field contains additional data, which may be required for a particular request. |
| amount | object | Yes | A container object for the payable amount information of the transaction. |
|   - currency | string | Yes | The three-character [ISO currency code](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes#currency-codes) of the amount. |
|   - value | integer | Yes | The numeric value of the amount, in [minor units](https://docs.adyen.com/development-resources/currency-codes#minor-units). |
| bank | object | No | A container for bank account data.  This field is mandatory if `card` is not provided. |
|   - bankAccountNumber | string | No | The bank account number (without separators). |
|   - bankCity | string | No | The bank city. |
|   - bankLocationId | string | No | The location id of the bank. The field value is `nil` in most cases. |
|   - bankName | string | No | The name of the bank. |
|   - bic | string | No | The [Business Identifier Code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_9362) (BIC) is the SWIFT address assigned to a bank. The field value is `nil` in most cases. |
|   - countryCode | string | No | Country code where the bank is located.  A valid value is an ISO two-character country code (e.g. 'NL'). |
|   - iban | string | No | The [International Bank Account Number](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/International_Bank_Account_Number) (IBAN). |
|   - ownerName | string | No | The name of the bank account holder. If you submit a name with non-Latin characters, we automatically replace some of them with corresponding Latin characters to meet the FATF recommendations. For example:  - χ12 is converted to ch12.  - üA is converted to euA.  Peter Møller is converted to Peter Mller, because banks don't accept 'ø'. After replacement, the ownerName must have at least three alphanumeric characters (A-Z, a-z, 0-9), and at least one of them must be a valid Latin character (A-Z, a-z). For example: - John17 - allowed.  - J17 - allowed.  - 171 - not allowed.  - John-7 - allowed.  If provided details don't match the required format, the response returns the error message: 203 'Invalid bank account holder name'. |
|   - taxId | string | No | The bank account holder's tax ID. |
| billingAddress | object | No | The billing address.  The `billingAddress` object is required for cross-border payouts to and from Canada. Include all of the fields within this object. |
|   - city | string | Yes | The name of the city. Maximum length: 3000 characters. |
|   - country | string | Yes | The two-character ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 country code. For example, **US**.  If you don't know the country or are not collecting the country from the shopper, provide `country` as `ZZ`. |
|   - houseNumberOrName | string | Yes | The number or name of the house. Maximum length: 3000 characters. |
|   - postalCode | string | Yes | A maximum of five digits for an address in the US, or a maximum of ten characters for an address in all other countries. |
|   - stateOrProvince | string | No | The two-character ISO 3166-2 state or province code. For example, **CA** in the US or **ON** in Canada.  Required for the US and Canada. |
|   - street | string | Yes | The name of the street. Maximum length: 3000 characters.  The house number should not be included in this field; it should be separately provided via `houseNumberOrName`. |
| card | object | No | A container for card data.  This field is mandatory if `bank` is not provided. |
|   - cvc | string | No | The [card verification code](https://docs.adyen.com/payments-fundamentals/payment-glossary#card-security-code-cvc-cvv-cid) (1-20 characters). Depending on the card brand, it is known also as:  - CVV2/CVC2 – length: 3 digits  - CID – length: 4 digits  If you are using [Client-Side Encryption](https://docs.adyen.com/classic-integration/cse-integration-ecommerce), the CVC code is present in the encrypted data. You must never post the card details to the server. This field must be always present in a [one-click payment request](https://docs.adyen.com/classic-integration/recurring-payments). When this value is returned in a response, it is always empty because it is not stored. |
|   - expiryMonth | string | No | The card expiry month. Format: 2 digits, zero-padded for single digits. For example:  - 03 = March  - 11 = November |
|   - expiryYear | string | No | The card expiry year. Format: 4 digits. For example: 2020 |
|   - holderName | string | No | The name of the cardholder, as printed on the card. |
|   - issueNumber | string | No | The issue number of the card (for some UK debit cards only). |
|   - number | string | No | The card number (4-19 characters). Do not use any separators. When this value is returned in a response, only the last 4 digits of the card number are returned. |
|   - startMonth | string | No | The month component of the start date (for some UK debit cards only). |
|   - startYear | string | No | The year component of the start date (for some UK debit cards only). |
| dateOfBirth | string | Yes | The date of birth. Format: [ISO-8601](https://www.w3.org/TR/NOTE-datetime); example: YYYY-MM-DD For Paysafecard it must be the same as used when registering the Paysafecard account.  This field is mandatory for natural persons. |
| entityType | string | Yes | The type of the entity the payout is processed for. |
| fraudOffset | integer | No | An integer value that is added to the normal fraud score. The value can be either positive or negative. |
| merchantAccount | string | Yes | The merchant account identifier, with which you want to process the transaction. |
| nationality | string | Yes | The shopper's nationality.  A valid value is an ISO 2-character country code (e.g. 'NL'). |
| recurring | object | Yes | A container for the type of recurring contract to be retrieved.  The recurring.contract must be set to `PAYOUT` |
|   - contract | string | No | The type of recurring contract to be used. Possible values:  - `ONECLICK` – Payment details can be used to initiate a one-click payment, where the shopper enters the [card security code (CVC/CVV)](https://docs.adyen.com/payments-fundamentals/payment-glossary#card-security-code-cvc-cvv-cid).  - `RECURRING` – Payment details can be used without the card security code to initiate [card-not-present transactions](https://docs.adyen.com/payments-fundamentals/payment-glossary#card-not-present-cnp).  - `ONECLICK,RECURRING` – Payment details can be used regardless of whether the shopper is on your site or not.  - `PAYOUT` – Payment details can be used to [make a payout](https://docs.adyen.com/online-payments/online-payouts).  - `EXTERNAL` - Use this when you store payment details and send the raw card number or network token directly in your API request. |
|   - recurringDetailName | string | No | A descriptive name for this detail. |
|   - recurringExpiry | string | No | Date after which no further authorisations shall be performed. Only for 3D Secure 2. |
|   - recurringFrequency | string | No | Minimum number of days between authorisations. Only for 3D Secure 2. |
|   - tokenService | string | No | The name of the token service. |
| reference | string | Yes | The merchant reference for this payment. This reference will be used in all communication to the merchant about the status of the payout. Although it is a good idea to make sure it is unique, this is not a requirement. |
| selectedBrand | string | No | The name of the brand to make a payout to.  For Paysafecard it must be set to `paysafecard`. |
| shopperEmail | string | Yes | The shopper's email address. |
| shopperName | object | No | The shopper's name.  When the `entityType` is `Company`, the `shopperName.lastName` must contain the company name. |
|   - firstName | string | Yes | The first name. |
|   - lastName | string | Yes | The last name. |
| shopperReference | string | Yes | The shopper's reference for the payment transaction. |
| shopperStatement | string | No | The description of this payout. This description is shown on the bank statement of the shopper (if this is supported by the chosen payment method). |
| socialSecurityNumber | string | No | The shopper's social security number. |
| telephoneNumber | string | No | The shopper's phone number. |

## Responses

### 200 Success
The request has succeeded.

**Response body**
| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| additionalData | object (string) | No | This field contains additional data, which may be returned in a particular response. |
| pspReference | string | Yes | A new reference to uniquely identify this request. |
| refusalReason | string | No | In case of refusal, an informational message for the reason. |
| resultCode | string | Yes | The response:  - In case of success is payout-submit-received.  - In case of an error, an informational message is returned. |


### 400 Client Error
A problem reading or understanding the request.

**Response body**
| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|------|------|----------|-------------|
| additionalData | object (string) | No | Contains additional information about the payment. Some data fields are included only if you select them first. Go to **Customer Area** > **Developers** > **Additional data**. |
| errorCode | string | No | The error code mapped to the error message. |
| errorType | string | No | The category of the error. |
| message | string | No | A short explanation of the issue. |
| pspReference | string | No | The PSP reference of the payment. |
| status | integer | No | The HTTP response status. |
